title: Viral
summary: Check two sources, disclose the misleading crop and present a permitted written package with a withdrawal-safe document route.

stages.title: Forwarded many times. Checked how often?
stages.text:
KC receives a forwarded claim: 'The 21:14 stamp proves theft.' He sets it beside two source descriptions.
Ngozi: A stamp can tell time without telling the whole story.
KC: My old crop helped the wrong story travel. I need to correct that too.
stages.summary: KC receives a forwarded claim: 'The 21:14 stamp proves theft.' He sets it beside two source descriptions.

stages.text: Read the two records, select what each supports and explicitly check. Free guidance selects the same answers. No timer, battery charge or penalty applies.

stages.title: The edit was mine
stages.text:
KC keeps the earlier confession on record, including any delay. The correction now names his own action without blaming a worker or pretending the crop was accidental.
KC: The missing bit was not hiding. I removed it.

choices.label: Prepare a clear correction beside the earlier edit

admit.text: KC had admitted the crop earlier. He now makes the correction readable to the same fictional audience.
admit.summary: Follow the earlier admission with a visible correction.

defer.text: KC had delayed the admission. He now says plainly that he made the crop; the delay remains part of the record.
defer.summary: Repair the delayed confession with a clear admission.

stages.title: Keep the disclosure attached
stages.text: Choose a plain admission, a permitted public visual and a caption that keeps uncertainty. The source description can be checked privately; raw private footage is not part of the public package.
stages.summary: Choose a plain admission, a permitted public visual and a caption that keeps uncertainty. The source description can be checked privately; raw private footage is not part of the public package.

choices.label: Save the checked correction and disclosure

stages.title: Permission has a present tense
stages.text: NE-1 covers only its exact approved redacted words. It never covers a name, face, voice or new quotation. Keep that permission only if it is current, withdraw it, or use permitted anonymised documents. Every route can finish this chapter.

stages.title: Choose the material, not the loudest headline
stages.text: Both source routes carry the same correction and chapter reward. The witness route uses the exact NE-1 redacted written text only. The document route uses permitted anonymised SR-18/CAT-18 extracts. Private accounts, the original recording and the diary remain outside this package.

stages.title: Read what the audience will receive
stages.text: The current presentation is shown below. Check its disclosure, exact words and source limits. Withdrawing permission switches the current presentation to documents. No private original, extra quote or worker identity is included.

stages.title: Three views. Two are yours.
stages.text:
The first audience counter reads three.
Tunde: Two are you checking the caption.
KC: The third one read it. That is a start.
Ngozi keeps the transport reservation and staging agreement ready for the community questions. The correction does not settle every allegation or change the property inventory.
stages.summary: The first audience counter reads three.

choices.label: Keep the correction and source limits with the dossier

stages.title: Attention is not the same as trust
stages.text:
Viral complete. KC gains three mastery once. His correction and current source package join the journal as a presentation record. Prior choices, property custody, transport and private sources stay recorded.

Promises, Promises follows.
